posts.text:
Following the ICE shooting of a man in Texas, I asked @RepSylviaGarcia if people should believe DHS vow to investigate:

“No. You know, that's like the fox guarding the henhouse…and when you look at the Renee Goode case, it's been over six months. We've not had a report. There's been no accountability…This is Texas. We don't put up with horseshit.”

Question: This war was supposed to have been already won. Is this a problem for the president?

@BradOnMessage: “Yes, I think walking away was a problem for the president, first off as well. I mean, the MOU was wildly unpopular among the president's base voters, who are generally very hawkish and very anti-Iran.”

These words from the NATO summit declaration are significant given Trump’s statement just yesterday that the war doesn’t matter to the U.S.: 

“Ukraine contributes to transatlantic security, and Allies stand united in our unwavering support for Ukraine in defending its freedom, sovereignty, and territorial integrity.“
